variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: scientific naturalistic bird illustration, flight variant for an identification app.
Input image 1 is the ONLY EDIT TARGET and the ONLY reference for anatomy, pixel geometry, pose, style, feather structure and composition: the normal adult Eurasian goshawk (Habicht).
EDIT THIS IMAGE IN PLACE; change plumage pigmentation only to an adult isabelline beige color aberration. Convert all dark gray/brown/black plumage tones into pale muted sandy beige and soft warm light brown; pale feather areas become delicate cream. Retain clearly readable but subdued fine light-brown transverse barring on breast/belly, wing undersides and tail. Soft sandy beige head with a cream eyebrow. Keep the orange adult iris and yellow cere and feet, dark beak and dark claw tips. This is a diluted sand-beige isabelline bird, NOT a rusty orange or white albidus bird.
Strictly immutable: square canvas format; exact position and scale of entire bird; silhouette; pose; downward viewpoint; head looking left; wing axis lower left to upper right; every feather outline, tip, overlap, wing joint, body contour, eye/beak/foot position, tail shape; perspective; lighting; same detailed naturalistic illustration rendering. Do not redraw, rotate, translate, crop, expand, shrink or recompose the bird. Preserve full wings and tail tips. Paint the new colors directly over the existing feathers without changing their placement.
Background must be genuine transparent alpha, absolutely no rendered checkerboard or opaque background, no shadow, no text, no extra objects. Output one image only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: scientific naturalistic bird illustration, juvenile flight variant for an identification app.
Input image 1 is the ONLY EDIT TARGET and the ONLY reference for anatomy, pixel geometry, pose, style, feather structure and composition: the NORMAL ADULT Eurasian goshawk (Habicht). This juvenile must be edited directly from that original, not from any other variant.
EDIT THIS IMAGE IN PLACE; change only plumage pigmentation and necessary age markings to a JUVENILE ISABELLINE beige color aberration. Overall gentle sandy beige / cream plumage with muted pale warm light-brown markings, NOT rusty orange and NOT white albidus. Replace the adult fine transverse barring on the breast and belly with natural juvenile lengthwise teardrop streaks in light warm brown on cream. Preserve softly banded flight feathers and tail, diluted into pale beige and cream. Head softly sandy beige with cream eyebrow. Change the adult orange iris to a pale yellow juvenile iris; retain yellow cere and feet, dark beak and dark claw tips.
Strictly immutable: square canvas format; exact position and scale of entire bird; silhouette; pose; downward viewpoint; head looking left; wing axis lower left to upper right; every feather outline, tip, overlap, wing joint, body contour, eye/beak/foot position, tail shape; perspective; lighting; same detailed naturalistic illustration rendering. Do not redraw, rotate, translate, crop, expand, shrink or recompose the bird. Preserve full wings and tail tips. Paint only plumage colors and age patterns over existing geometry.
Background must be genuine transparent alpha, absolutely no rendered checkerboard or opaque background, no shadow, no text, no extra objects. Output one image only.
